                                           Cinematography Add-On: Same Day Edit
                                           Our same-day-edit (SDE) wedding video package is a cinematic film
                                           that tells your wedding day story from the bride and groom's
                                           perspective, usually running for 3 to 4 minutes.

                                           This package includes footage from the ceremony or pre-ceremony,
                                           along with other defining moments that have taken place earlier in the
                                           day. The SDE video is typically shown to guests during the evening
                                           reception, providing them with an opportunity to relive some of the
                                           most precious moments of the day.

                                           Choosing an SDE video has several benefits. Most wedding videos take
                                           several months to produce, which can be a source of anxiety for many
                                           couples. With an SDE video, couples can have a great preview of how
                                           the final video will look on the same day. Additionally, it allows guests
                                           who may not have attended the ceremony or other parts of the
                                           wedding to feel like they were a part of the entire event.

                                           Please note that this add-on service requires a 2-camera shoot, and a
                                           TV monitor is needed from your DJ or can be provided for an extra
                                           charge.
                                                                                                             $1,750
